title: Regularity of a Multidimensional Principal-Agent Problem with Separable Effort Costs
summary: This paper studies the regularity of the value function arising from a multidimensional continuous-time principal-agent model with separable, nonquadratic effort costs. The associated stochastic control problem has the output and the agent's continuation utility as state variables, and its Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman equation is fully nonlinear and degenerate, with potentially unbounded coefficients.
